meta.title: fal.live: AI Television Directed by Everyone
meta.description: fal.live is fal.ai's live channel platform: a resident Director prompt sets the world, chat proposes and votes, the winning scene renders in seconds, 24/7.

h1: fal.live: one Director session, a whole audience steering

faqs.a: fal.ai's platform for live, audience-directed channels. Each channel runs a single realtime Director session that is broadcast to every viewer at once — official tagline: "AI television directed by everyone."

faqs.q: How does voting on fal.live work?
faqs.a: Viewers propose directions in chat and the room votes. The top-voted prompt becomes the instruction for the next scene, which is generated live within seconds. The channel keeps running 24/7 whether you participate or just watch.

faqs.q: Who writes the show on fal.live?
faqs.a: Each channel's creator writes a system prompt that acts as its resident director — the worldview, characters, and tone. From then on, that prompt directs every scene while the audience supplies the story beats.
